correctness.rationale: In odd characteristic ordinary commutator [X,Y]=2(u∧v+u∧t+s∧v); even and degree-five coordinates contribute q^34. For u∧v=a!=0 simple, SL_2(q) gives q(q²-1) degree-one pairs and the linear map on two cubic forms is onto Λ4V (rank5), giving q^50(q²-1) fibers. For a=0, zero u=v contributes q^20 only to b=0; nonzero dependent u,v span a line and the map has rank4, and for b!=0 the eligible lines are in the four-dimensional annihilator of b. This recovers both a=0 formulas. Non-simple bivectors are outside the image. Every bivector in dim5 is sum of <=2 simples, and e12+e34 requires two. Independently checked total weighted target mass simplifies exactly to q^64 and compared source literal wedge-multiplication checker.
residual_risks: Computations are bounded corroboration; arbitrary-domain correctness follows from the mathematical block, wedge, orbit or EF proof, not finite tests.
